task: Who's got a virtual machine and is about to play through an profound round of TextWorld? You do! Here is your task for today. First thing I need you to do is to take a trip east. Then, recover the passkey from the floor of the chamber. And then, head west. If you can succeed at that, assure that the gateway is unlocked. After that, open the gateway. And then, take a trip south. Then, venture south. And then, move south. If you can finish that, move east. Then, make an effort to head north. Then, go east. After that, attempt to go to the east. And then, go to the east. With that accomplished, lift the Quote of the Day Calendar from the floor of the cubicle. That's it!
